ItemID: NA; Title: Shania Twain - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in revisiting older pop and rock than country hits right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Enya; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for familiar pop songs rather than an atmospheric listening session today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Tornado; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to choose it over familiar hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my recent interest in mid-sixties songs and nostalgic greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Daryl Hall & John Oates; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Their melodic pop fits the mood of my Cars and classic-hits listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Based on a True Story...; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell enough from this title to expect a strong match with my current listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ultimate Hits: Rock And Roll Never Forgets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A rock hits collection appeals to the same familiar-song mood as Now Classic Rock Hits.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits: Straight Up!; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A hits collection is appealing, but I do not recognize enough here to choose it this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: All the Great Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether these are songs I would want to revisit.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am in the mood for pop and rock songs rather than relaxing classical music.
